details.STATUS: India's largest commercial port. Primary IMEC eastern departure point. India committed $10B to port modernization nationally.

details.OPERATOR: Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority. APM Terminals (Maersk, Denmark) operates one terminal.
details.STATUS: India's largest container port. Secondary IMEC departure node. Vadhavan deep-water port (under construction nearby) will become primary gateway.

name: JEBEL ALI PORT

details.OWNER: DP World (Dubai Ports World) — Dubai Government entity
details.OPERATOR: DP World. Largest port in the Middle East. World's 9th busiest container port.
details.STATUS: Primary IMEC Gulf hub. Inside the Strait of Hormuz — vulnerable to Iranian closure. 2026 Hormuz crisis directly impacted operations.

alert: ⚠ Inside Strait of Hormuz. Iran's Feb 2026 closure directly threatened this node.

name: KHALIFA PORT

details.OWNER: AD Ports Group (Abu Dhabi Government) — majority. CMA CGM (France) operates one terminal.
details.OPERATOR: AD Ports Group + CMA CGM Terminal (France, $800M investment 2025)
details.STATUS: Official IMEC MOU designated Gulf hub. Also inside Hormuz. French CMA CGM presence = EU embedded in this node.

alert: ⚠ Inside Strait of Hormuz. Hormuz bypass via Fujairah/Oman increasingly critical.

details.OWNER: Fujairah Government (UAE). DP World operates terminals.
details.OPERATOR: DP World (Dubai). Only UAE emirate port outside the Strait of Hormuz.
details.STATUS: Emerging as IMEC's Hormuz-bypass alternative. Sits on Gulf of Oman, Indian Ocean side. Critical if Hormuz stays closed.

details.OPERATOR: Saudi Ports Authority. APM Terminals (Maersk/Denmark) operates container terminal.
details.STATUS: Key IMEC Gulf relay point. Rail connection to Haifa planned via Saudi rail network. Also Persian Gulf side — Hormuz-exposed.

name: PORT OF HAIFA(SPLIT — TWO OPERATORS)

details.OLD PORT: Adani Ports (India) 70% + Gadot (Israel) 30%. Acquired Jan 2023 for $1.15B. US lobbied hard for India to win.
details.NEW BAY PORT: SIPG — Shanghai International Port Group (China, state-owned). 25-year concession until 2040. Built for $930M.
details.GAP: 1.8 km separates the Indian-owned old port from China's new terminal. China's port sits adjacent to Israel's main naval base.

tag: ⚠ MOST CONTESTED NODE ON THE BOARD
alert: 🔴 China operates a terminal 1.8km from Israel's navy. SIPG concession runs to 2040. US pushing Israel to invoke "public interest" clause. During Feb 2026 Iran strikes on Haifa, SIPG terminal was operational — collecting intelligence through the crisis.

name: PORT OF PIRAEUS

details.OWNER: COSCO Shipping (China, state-owned, PLA-linked) — 67% majority stake. Greek state retains 33%.
details.OPERATOR: Piraeus Port Authority (PPA) — COSCO controlled. Acquired 2016 for ~€368M.
details.STATUS: Designated IMEC European gateway in original MOU — but operated by China. Revenue doubled since COSCO acquisition. EU now treating this as a strategic blunder. COSCO was Pentagon-blacklisted Jan 2025 for PLA links.

alert: 🔴 CRITICAL: IMEC's original European endpoint is operated by a Pentagon-blacklisted Chinese state company. Italy (Trieste) and France (Marseille) are being pushed as alternatives precisely because of this. "Piraeus was a wake-up call" — former US Ambassador to Greece.

details.OWNER: Oman government majority + APM Terminals (Maersk, Denmark) — significant stake
details.OPERATOR: Salalah Port Services (APM Terminals partnership). World's 2nd most efficient container facility (2025 ranking).
details.STATUS: Key Hormuz bypass. Outside the strait on the Arabian Sea. Vital during 2026 closure. Part of proposed IMEC Oman extension.

name: PORT OF DUQM

details.OWNER: Oman government. China has China-Oman Industrial Park in SEZ. US, UK, India have defense access agreements.
details.OPERATOR: ASYAD Group (Oman state). Adani Group in talks for SEZ development. Hutchison Ports (HK) at Khasab (nearby Musandam).
details.STATUS: Most contested port on this list. US aircraft carriers have access. China industrial park operates inside. India Adani negotiating SEZ. Multiple superpowers simultaneously embedded here.

tag: ⚡ US + CHINA + INDIA — ALL INSIDE ONE PORT
alert: 🟡 The most geopolitically complex port in the world: US carriers, Chinese industry, Indian investment, all operating simultaneously in one Omani port. Oman's neutrality is the only thing keeping this from exploding.

location: Somaliland — Gulf of Aden / Bab al-Mandab
name: PORT OF BERBERA

details.OWNER: Somaliland government. DP World (UAE) — majority concession operator. Ethiopia has equity stake.
details.OPERATOR: DP World (UAE, Dubai Government). 30-year concession. Israel recognized Somaliland Dec 2025 — potential Israeli military/intelligence presence emerging.
details.STATUS: 300km from Houthi-controlled Yemen. Flanks the Bab al-Mandab southern chokepoint. UAE + Israel = implicit control of the Red Sea's southern entry. Saudi Arabia condemns Israel's Somaliland recognition.

location: Italy — Northern Adriatic (EU alternative to Piraeus)
name: PORT OF TRIESTE

details.OWNER: Port Network Authority of the Eastern Adriatic Sea (Italian state). Germany's Deutsche Bahn has rail freight partnerships.
details.OPERATOR: Port Network Authority. Italy appointed IMEC Special Envoy (Apr 2025) specifically to push Trieste as EU gateway. Connected by rail directly to Austria, Germany, and Central Europe.
details.STATUS: Italy's main candidate to replace Piraeus as IMEC European endpoint. No Chinese presence. Rail links to EU economic core.

details.OPERATOR: China Overseas Ports Holding. Pakistan's strategic access to Arabian Sea via $62B CPEC corridor.
details.STATUS: China's Arabian Sea anchor. Flanks India's IMEC western flank. Pakistani military protection. Part of why India-Pakistan tensions map to the corridor — Gwadar is China's counter-IMEC foothold.

details.OWNER: China Merchants Port Holdings — 70% stake, 99-year lease (2017–2116)
details.OPERATOR: China Merchants Port Holdings. Sri Lanka defaulted on Chinese loans, surrendered the port.
details.STATUS: The original "debt-trap" port. Sits on India's sea lanes. China has a 99-year lease. Template for the BRI port acquisition strategy.

name: DORALEH MULTIPURPOSE PORT + CHINA NAVAL BASE

details.OWNER: China Merchants Holdings — 23.5% stake in port. China has separate military base (opened 2017) adjacent to port.
details.OPERATOR: Djibouti Ports & Free Zones Authority. China Merchants port operations. Chinese PLA at military base.
details.STATUS: China's only overseas military base. Sits at the Bab al-Mandab strait — the Red Sea chokepoint. US also has Camp Lemonnier (largest US overseas military base) nearby. The two superpowers share a 10km radius.

tag: 🔴 CHINA MILITARY BASE AT BAB AL-MANDAB
alert: 🔴 China's military base and the US's Camp Lemonnier are both at Djibouti — 10km apart — both watching the same chokepoint the Houthis have been attacking since 2023.

details.OWNER: COSCO Shipping (China, state-owned, Pentagon-blacklisted) — 60% stake, 30-year exclusive rights
details.OPERATOR: COSCO Shipping Ports. Xi Jinping inaugurated remotely Nov 2024 at APEC Lima. COSCO demanded exclusive right to control all port services — resisted by Peru, then Peru acquiesced.
details.STATUS: China's gateway to South America. Bypasses Panama Canal. Part of Venezuela/Cuba/Nicaragua corridor strategy in Western Hemisphere.

name: BALBOA PORT + CRISTÓBAL PORT

details.WAS: CK Hutchison (Hong Kong) — operated since 1997 under 25-year concession. Panama also granted a no-bid 25-year extension that triggered the constitutional crisis.
details.DEAL: Mar 2025: BlackRock + GIP + TIL (MSC subsidiary) agreed to buy 43 Hutchison ports globally for $22.8B, including 90% of Panama Ports Company (Balboa + Cristóbal).
details.CHINA BLOCKS: China's SAMR launched antitrust review Mar 2025, effectively halting the sale. Beijing called it "kowtowing" to US pressure. COSCO then demanded a majority stake in the deal — BlackRock and MSC considered walking away.
details.COURT: Panama Supreme Court ruled Hutchison concessions unconstitutional. Feb 24, 2026: Panama officially voided/annulled Hutchison contracts.
details.NOW: Maersk + MSC took interim operational control (Feb 2026). CK Hutchison initiated international arbitration against Panama. BlackRock deal future uncertain. Trump declared victory; China called it fabricated pretext.

tag: ⚡ MOST CONTESTED PORT DEAL IN HISTORY
alert: 🔴 STATUS APR 2026: Legally unresolved. Maersk/MSC running interim ops. BlackRock deal may be dead (COSCO demanded majority; exclusivity expired Jul 2025). Panama Supreme Court voided Hutchison — but Hutchison is suing. If Panama relaunches auction, BlackRock, COSCO, and DP World are all possible bidders. Trump declared this a Donroe Doctrine win regardless.

location: Peru — Pacific (South America, China's new gateway)
name: PORT OF CHANCAY

details.OWNER: COSCO Shipping (China state, Pentagon-blacklisted) — 60% stake, 30-year exclusivity
details.STATUS: Xi Jinping inaugurated Nov 2024 at APEC Lima. Bypasses Panama Canal entirely — direct China–South America route. COSCO demanded control of all port services (tugs, pilots, fuel, waste) — Peru resisted, then acquiesced. Under Donroe Doctrine, this is Target #2 in South America after Venezuela.
details.DONROE: US 2025 NSS explicitly targets non-hemispheric powers owning "strategically vital assets." Chancay is the clearest example in South America. No US action taken yet — Venezuela was first.

location: Venezuela — Caribbean (largest proven oil reserves on Earth)
name: VENEZUELA — JOSÉ TERMINAL + MARACAIBO OIL INFRASTRUCTURE

details.WAS: PDVSA (Venezuela state) with Chinese "oil-for-debt" agreements giving China first claim on oil exports. China lent $60B+, repaid in oil. Venezuela was China's largest Western Hemisphere energy source.
details.NOW: Jan 3, 2026: Operation Absolute Resolve. Maduro captured. US DEA + military. Trump: "This is OUR Hemisphere." US claims it will "run Venezuela." Venezuelan government technically still in place. US access to oil reserves asserted.
details.EFFECT: Severs China's biggest Western Hemisphere energy lifeline. Cuts Russia's last Caribbean proxy. Cuba and Nicaragua signaled as next targets.

alert: 🟡 China loses $60B+ in oil-for-debt agreements overnight. China is now the #2 user of the Panama Canal — after the US — and Venezuela was its hemispheric energy base. Both severed within 3 months in early 2026.

location: Arctic — Greenland (Danish territory, strategic Arctic anchor)
name: GREENLAND — NUUK PORT + ARCTIC ROUTES

details.OWNER: Kingdom of Denmark. Greenland Self-Government (Naalakkersuisut) has autonomy. No US ownership — yet.
details.WHY IT MATTERS: Controls the GIUK Gap (Greenland-Iceland-UK) — NATO's critical North Atlantic chokepoint. Arctic melting opens "Polar Silk Road" — China declared itself a "near-Arctic state." Greenland has rare earth minerals China currently monopolizes globally. US needs it to block both China's Arctic route and Russia's submarine access to the Atlantic.
details.STATUS: Trump demanded purchase/acquisition repeatedly. JD Vance visited Mar 2025. Denmark PM: "if US attacks a NATO member, everything stops." Trump ruled out military force for Canada — not explicitly for Greenland. Katie Miller: "soon." Greenland independence vote gaining momentum — possible pathway for US deal.

tag: ⚡ ARCTIC CORRIDOR — CHINA'S POLAR SILK ROAD COUNTER
